Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Enable headset of ASUS UX482EG & B9400CEA with ALC294

Some laptops like ASUS UX482EG & B9400CEA's headset audio does not work
until the quirk ALC294_FIXUP_ASUS_HPE is applied.
